dedupe_keys.name: nga east geotechnical working group seismic site response simulation database

description: NGA-East Geotechnical Working Group Seismic Site Response Simulation Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Youssef Hashash, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). This project includes the NoSQL database of 1,747,278 one-dimensional seismic site response simulations (582,426 of each linear, equivalent-linear and nonlinear simulations) developed for the large-scale parametric study described in Harmon et al. (2018) to inform new amplification models for Central and Eastern North America (CENA). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2P67X. Keywords: NGA-East, Site Response, GWG-S, NoSQL Database Files. Published 2018-09-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
